|lore=Made by Genetech. Unusually independent for a droid. Forced to serve a Moff on Firro, but was liberated by Tiree. Now dedicated to serving the Alliance.
|game_text=Once per turn, may place your non-droid character just lost at same or related site in Used Pile instead of Lost Pile. X on Bacta Tank is -2.

|notes=The 2006 slip restates the Used Pile replacement and expresses the Bacta Tank cost modifier as X is -2. The [[2-1B (Too-Onebee) (V) (Virtual Set 4: Battle Of Hoth) (Original)|original-edition slip]] survives in the exact release PDF created on 4 February 2003. The sheet gives 5 February as the sanctioned legality date. The [[2-1B (Too-Onebee) (V) (Virtual Set 4: Battle Of Hoth) (Remastered 2006)|2006 publication]] gives its text as of 4 December 2006.
